acceptanceCriteria: A completed ticket after N no-progress hand-offs is not alerted; an open ticket still is; held and archived tickets behave as specified, each with a focused regression test.
The owning spec carries numbered requirements for the terminal/held exclusion.
body:
Source: GitHub beamfall/corvint#791.

Observed: `corvint-tasks doctor` lists COMPLETED tickets as NO_PROGRESS_HANDOFF (e.g. "30 consecutive hand-offs with no gate result, review or new candidate tree"); in one run 3 of 15 alerts were completed tickets. Completion does not reset the hand-off streak; only gate results, reviews and new candidate trees do.

Expected: a ticket whose current status is COMPLETED, ARCHIVED or HELD is not reported as a no-progress hand-off loop; completion ends the streak.

Out of scope here (separate follow-ups): ~55 s scan of 4096 receipts on a ~30k-receipt journal; documenting whether `--line` reuses a cached scan.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#799 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/799; landed by batch PR #799); on main at 10efc02d16e6069d73426e6d6abd860e71ae83ab (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/799). Tests named in the PR: TQD-V0-013 tasks doctor tests. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: tasks doctor reports NO_PROGRESS_HANDOFF for tickets already COMPLETED (GH #791)
